meta.name: Shiksha Mandal
meta.description:
The series, inspired by true events, takes you through the medical entrance exam scam in the state of Madhya Pradesh. The Shiksha Mandal story is of a medical aspirant, Vidya and many others like her who are caught in a web of corruption, manipulation and crimes at a tender age only because they are good students. Vidya and many other well-scoring students are made to take the medical entrance exam, not for themselves but on fake IDs. From the coaching centres to university deans, from examination boards to the police, from media to top government officials all are involved in this corrupt system producing fake doctors and medical students with no merit every year. The scammers are exposed only when a special STF officer, Anuradha, is assigned to the task. But with so many players involved the game is not easy. Will Anuradha be able to get to the top of the scam or will the scam unveil become bigger than everything else?

Ended · First aired 15 Sept 2022 · India · Language: Hindi · 40 min
Studio: MX Player · Network: MX Player

Complete series. On your server: S1 9/9

On your server — Audio: Hindi

videos.title: Entrance Exam
videos.overview: Prabhakar is been forced to attempt the medical entrance exam as Anuj Vyas, He notices Vidya in the same exam hall. Aditya is very excited about the upcoming medical entrance results for all his students and especially for Vidya. Vidya is tense and seeks the help of Rahul Somani, Rahul promises Vidya that before the results are out and Aditya comes to know about it the truth about the scam will be out. Rahul tries to connect with his father but due to party meetings, he could not reach out. in meantime, Dhansu orders his men to get Rahul and the pen drive but during the scuffle between Dhansu`s men and Rahul, Rahul dies. The result day arrives, and Vidya has no option left but to suicide because anytime her brother will come to know that she was absent in her entrance, as Vidya is about to jump from the bridge Dhansu`s men kidnap her.

videos.title: Fake ID
videos.overview: Dhansu is pissed off with his men because Rahul Somani is Ex-minister Prakash Somani`s son and it is a high-profile case. SHO Jungle Singh is Dhansu`s man so he tries to close the case but Swades his associate does not like it and tries to investigate further. Aditya is shaken to learn about Vidya, he is clueless why Vidya has done this. He is frantically searching for her. We see Sharma who softly threatens a few students to be prepared to attend the upcoming medical entrance exam on a fake ID. Aditya reaches out to Yash, Vidya`s boyfriend who reveals that someone filmed them when they were in a hotel room and Vidya is getting blackmailed. Aditya is shocked. We see a talent hostel where Dhanu`s men are preparing students to attend medical entrance exams on fake IDs.Dhansu tries to give a bribe to a junior secretary of the education department in the meantime Prabhakar and his friends plead to Dhansu to release them. One of Prabhakar`s friends gets killed suspiciously in the theatre.

videos.title: Exam Racket
videos.overview: Prakash Somani pressurizes the government and handover the investigation about his son`s killing to STF, meanwhile, Anuradha STF officer successfully catches Indore medical entrance exam scam chief. Due to this Anuradha Shrivastava is been appointed as an investigative officer for the Bhopal case. Jungle explains to Dhansu that he should not worry now the case is officially transferred to STF he will make sure to interrupt the investigation. Swades realizes the ill motive of Jungle and unofficially tries to help Anuradha. Aditya finds out the call details of Vidya and does the FIR where he realizes Vidya was in touch with Rahul Somani. In parallel Swades also finds out and informs Anuradha that there is some connection between Vidya who is kidnapped and Rahul who is been killed.

videos.title: Pen Drive
videos.overview: Swades learns that his brother was also investigating the Indore Medical scam and finds links to the Bhopal scam as well. Aditya`s mother is shattered to learn what has happened with Vidya and falls from the stairs. While Aditya`s mother is getting treated in the hospital Aditya meets with his old student who is supposed to be in another city for his further medical studies, Aditya is suspicious of his behavior. Aditya and Shivani meet with a hacker and find out the location from she gets threatening calls. Aditya finds a cell phone and hands over it to Anuradha. Sharma notices Dr. Nanhe who was supposed to work for him is crossing him and preparing his batch of students. Vidya is been captured by Dhansu to recover a Pendrive. Vidya tries to elope but is nabbed by Akhtari Dhansu`s man Friday.

videos.title: Scam Victim
videos.overview: Dhansu beats up Dr. Nanhe from crossing Sharma. Aditya confronts his old student and he reveals how he was also a victim of the medical entrance scam mafia. Dhansu's men barged into Aditya`s house to recover Vidya`s laptop but they could not find anything. Dhansu threatens Vidya to tell the truth or else she will lose her and Aditya`s life. Nanhe calls up Aditya and shares what has happened with Vidya. Jungle Singh is forcing his son to take admitted to the science stream so that he can become a doctor but his son is not wishful. Anuradha and her team along with Aditya plant Prabhakar meet Dhansu again but Prabhakar gets killed by Jungle Singh as he promises Dhansu to interrupt the investigation.

videos.title: Fake Doctor
videos.overview: Shivani finds out a fake doctor and informs STF that it's not only about Vidya or a few other students the scam is much larger than just students, there are fake doctors in society. STF interrogates the fake doctor and gets the lead to the mafia. At the talent hostel due to ill-treatment one of the students falls from the terrace and the investigation starts. Aditya is still clueless about his sister and feels bad for Prabhakar`s death. The media has taken up the student death at the talent hostel and with the help of Dr. Nanhe Aditya finds out the link to reach Dhansu`s den.Kashyap an ex-bureaucrat calls up an urgent meeting with all the counterparts which include education ministries, Sharma, Madho Donald, Jungle Singh, etc.

videos.title: Tabela
videos.overview: Jungle finds his son has suicide and breaks down. Dhansu captures Aditya and orders his men to leave the place as STF must be on their way to Tabela. Dr Nanhe stabs Sharma and takes his revange. STF submits the proofs and declares that there is a medical entrance exam racket. While Aditya and Vidya are taken deep into the forest by Dhansu, Vidya plays a trick and asks Aditya to elope and get help. Shivani reaches out to one of the fake Dr and forces him to give an interview against the racket. Meanwhile, Swades also reach out to one of the students and gets the lead that there is a mole in Education Ministry. STF and Aditya interrogate a printer who works for Dhansu and finds out Dhansu`s destination in a forest.

videos.title: University Dream
videos.overview: While after the STF press conference government comes under the scanner, Kashyap orders his counterpart to take care of 5 MLAs who are with them and disconnect all the links immediately. Madho Donald asks Jungle to take care of STF activities but Jungle blasts on him as he has lost his son, in return Madho in anger kills Jungle`s wife. In between Somani meets with 5 MLAs who are important to forming the government and ask them to cooperate. Madho kidnaps them and Kahsyap ensures the Home minister that government is not in threat. STF attacks Dhansu`s den in Jungle and saves Vidya. Jungle joins Dhansu and reveals the info that Kashyap is playing the larger game and Dhansu is on his radar. Dhansu recovers the MLAs and informs Somani that if he saves him the MLAs will support his government but in return, Somani has to back his university dream.

videos.title: Question Mark
videos.overview: The home minister orders IG and home secretary to trap Aditya and close the case, STF has put up a case in court and Anuradha is taking Vidya along with her as a prime witness. Dhansu wants Vidya as she has the evidence of Dhansu is the mastermind of the medical entrance scam at the same time Madho Donald behind Anuradha stops the witness is reaching the court. CBI raids Aditya's coaching center and falsely arrests him with fake scam proof. Shivani reaches out to Somani to help, Somani meets with Aditya and offers him to join his party.Anuradha fights with Dhansu and there is a deadlock situation where Madho, Dhansu, and Anuradha stand in front of each other. Aditya is arrested and takes some decisions. What happens with Aditya, What happens with Anuradha and Vidya on this question mark we end the season?
